overall: The AG found no violation: a public body may review an Open Meeting Law complaint against its members in Purpose 1 executive session, and the complainant has no right to attend.

allegations.summary: Alleged the committee went into executive session improperly to discuss an Open Meeting Law complaint at its October 21, 2021 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Committee was permitted to conduct its review of such a complaint in executive session during the October 21, 2021, meeting, and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
